test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A mass of wax cells built by honey bees to store honey
solution: The correct answer is '**Honeycomb**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Honeycomb**'. • It means** 'a structure of holes (cells) with six sides, in which bees keep their eggs and the substance they produce (honey)** [छोटे-छोटे छिद्रोंवाली एक संरचना जिसमें मधुमक्खियाँ अपने अंडे तथा अपने द्वारा तैयार पदार्थ रखती हैं; शहद का छत्ता]'. • *Example: They are in fact, more complex structures involving a **honeycomb **of cracks and crevices in which bacteria thrive.* **Correct Answer:__** *Honeycomb.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Aviary**: a large cage or area in which birds are kept. (पक्षीशाला, दरबा) • **Beehive**: a type of box that people use for keeping bees in. (मधुमक्‍खी-पेटिका, मधुमक्‍खी का छत्ता) • **Apiary**: a place where bees are kept. (मधुवाटिका) 3d:T1043, The erroneous part is **'in much parts'.**
